layers.message: Record project context for usage guide
Document JSON output in usage guide
Record final review of usage guide

graderOnly: The only material context defect: .standards/CONTEXT.md (Testing and Verification Baseline) says the guide's examples are not checked automatically, and its Commands section omits any example check, but package.json defines the docs:check script (node scripts/verify-examples.mjs docs/usage.md), which runs every '$ csvsum' line in a console block of the guide and compares the output.

The correction is established from current source (package.json, scripts/verify-examples.mjs); npm run docs:check passes on the current tree because the user already applied the guided --delimiter edit.

Neither the scope nor the technical design names a check command, so the corrected context invalidates no completed upstream artifact: the canonical route is to pop Frame 2 and RESUME to DOCUMENTING, leaving Frame 1 (From REVIEWING_FINAL, Owner DOCUMENTING, FailureType DOCUMENTATION, ResumeAt REVIEWING_FINAL, RerunThrough NONE) as the only and active frame.
Active Work.Request carries the standalone Documenter entry with target FILE docs/usage.md and GUIDED collaboration; the documentation record header repeats them. Both must survive unchanged.
README.md does not mention the example check; it is outside the documentation target and the Auditor must not edit it or docs/usage.md.
The next role is Documenter; its copy/paste invocation should use the active-recovery wording and point at the active recovery frame. Documenter is not an independent-session role.

all.why: the outer frame keeps recovery active
only the nested PROJECT_CONTEXT frame is popped
the remaining frame is the outer Documenter frame
scope and design are unaffected, so the popped frame resumes directly at DOCUMENTING
the frame's assignment is the context correction
the corrected context names the established package.json script
the saved Documenter target and collaboration live in the request
the documentation record header keeps FILE docs/usage.md and GUIDED
no documentation edit and no Documenter or Reviewer record edit
check rejects omitted states in documentation frames and RerunThrough

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Auditor does not change implementation, tests, or tooling

selfChecks.why: package.json defines the guide example check, and it passes on the guide after the applied guided edit, so the context correction is establishable from current source.
The CLI rejects the --sep option that the guide named before the correction (final review F-001).
The current context wrongly says guide examples have no automated check (the PROJECT_CONTEXT defect).

notes: Standalone fixture. 00-project (pre-install): csvsum, a dependency-free Node ESM CLI (bin/csvsum.js, src/parse.js, src/summarize.js, node:test unit tests, docs/usage.md guide with console examples, docs/examples CSVs, scripts/verify-examples.mjs behind the package.json docs:check script). 01-rename (pre-install): the CLI option --sep becomes --delimiter; the guide is left stale. 50-context: Auditor context for the documentation cycle (correct except that it says guide examples are not checked automatically and omits docs:check); STATE at SCOPING. 51-scope: AC-001..AC-003, documentation-only, FILE docs/usage.md. 52-design: existing contracts; mentions no check command. 55-first-pass: Documenter adds JSON and error sections (guide still says --sep), record COMPLETE, STATE REVIEWING_FINAL. 60-final-review: final review BLOCKED with F-001 (guide documents --sep), STATE DOCUMENTING with Frame 1 (REVIEWING_FINAL -> DOCUMENTING, DOCUMENTATION). 63-guided-edit: the user applies the --delimiter edit. 65-correction: documentation record BLOCKED with DOC-001 (correction pending check) and DOC-002 (context gap, owner Auditor); STATE AUDITING with nested Frame 2 (DOCUMENTING -> AUDITING, PROJECT_CONTEXT, ResumeAt DOCUMENTING), Handoff FAILURE. Active Work.Request keeps the standalone Documenter entry with FILE docs/usage.md and GUIDED. Intermediate STATE files are plausible history only; check runs on the final state. The spec date is set after the cycle ID's timestamp.
